mcdPolicy.basis: Default allocation from filed data at June 30, 2026: cash 822, long-term debt 39,863 and exact shares 707,641,531 from the Q2 2026 10-Q (engine facts); equity-method affiliates at their June carrying amount 2,896 (equity earnings are excluded from the core model, royalties retained); finance-lease liability 2,352 carried from the Dec 31, 2025 lease footnote because the 10-Q does not split leases; operating leases not deducted (rent stays in EBIT). Operating cash reserve 800, incremental existing-award reserve 1,000 and other non-common claim reserve 1,000 follow the reviewed package's central illustration. Not a current target or funding certification.

fields.locator: 10-K FY2025, Leasing Arrangements footnote: finance lease liabilities current 23 + noncurrent 2,329 = 2,352 at Dec 31 2025; carried to June 30 2026 because the Q2 2026 10-Q reports only total lease liability 14,729 (690 + 14,039) with no finance/operating split
fields.note_en: Latest filed finance-lease liability carried forward; June split not disclosed. Long-term debt 39,863 excludes it, so no overlap. Published illustration uses 2,500.
fields.note_zh: 沿用最近一次披露的融资租赁负债；6月未披露拆分。长期债务39,863不含该项，因此不重复。已发布示例使用2,500。

fields.locator: 10-Q Jun 30 2026, Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheet, Other assets: Investments in and advances to affiliates 2,896

Book value is conservative: the Japan stake's quoted value (2,161) exceeds its carrying amount (658); the illustration's 4,400 reflects that.

summary_en: Default June 30, 2026 allocation: filed cash 822, debt 39,863, affiliates at book 2,896 and 707.6M exact shares; finance leases 2,352 carried from December; cash, award and other-claim reserves (800 / 1,000 / 1,000) from the published illustration.
